newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philiipines' Ramos up on feet, meets cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Philiipines' Ramos up on feet, meets cabinet.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos was on his feet on Tuesday, one day after undergoing surgery for removal of a blockage in a major artery, and met cabinet ministers in his hospital room.
Photographers and cameramen were allowed to see Ramos, who was waving an unlit cigar and smiling as he greeted members of the cabinet.

Ramos, 68, underwent a 75-minute operation on Monday for removal of a cholesterol blockage in the carotid artery on the right side of his neck, which is one of the major passages for blood flowing to the brain.
Officials had said the affliction could be life-threatening. But on Tuesday, there was little sign that Ramos was ill.
Dressed in a yellow T-shirt and hospital pyjamas, the president looked in good health. His wife Amelita and Vice-President Joseph Estrada were among those present at the meeting.
Doctors have said Ramos could be discharged on Wednesday or Thursday.
